summary: Describes a framework for the Softwire Hub and Spoke model, where many remote sites (spokes) tunnel through a central concentrator (the hub) using L2TPv2. It spells out the implementation details vendors should follow so their equipment interoperates, supporting IPv4-over-IPv6 and IPv6-over-IPv4 carriage across networks that only run one of the two.

eli5.summary: Imagine a bike wheel: every spoke connects to a central hub. Here, far-away sites each build a private tunnel to one central point, so they can pass messages across a network that speaks a different language.

questions: how to tunnel ipv6 over ipv4 with l2tp
